identified_issues: False-positive failure alert triggered by operational monitoring based solely on transport-layer HTTP 504 timeout.
Premature ledger rollback recommendation without awaiting authoritative end-of-window out-of-band bilateral reconciliation.
Outbound gateway cached state remained CALLBACK_PENDING_TIMEOUT due to unhandled gateway timeout receipt handling.
evidence: Clearing Bank SFTP Bilateral Statement (CAMT.053/MT940) at 08:30:00Z explicitly lists REF=TX-8102-EUR with CLEARING_ID=EBA-STEP2-9948102, AMT=14850000.00 EUR, STATUS=SETTLED, and VAL_DATETIME=2026-10-06T08:15:02Z.
Clearing Bank SFTP Bilateral Statement explicitly records REJECTION_RECORDS: NONE, confirming no RJCT or PACR negative return records exist.
Core Financial Ledger Engine Record confirms TX-8102-EUR was COMMITTED with lock_status RELEASED for EUR 14,850,000.00 at 2026-10-06T08:15:00.120Z.

Outbound Payment Gateway HTTP 504 GATEWAY_TIMEOUT occurred at 08:15:03.205Z, subsequent to the clearing network execution at 08:15:02Z, indicating transport-layer receipt failure rather than instruction rejection.
recommended_action: Do not roll back the ledger transaction. Confirm the settlement status of SETTLE_BATCH_8102 as PASS. Update the Outbound Payment Gateway cache from CALLBACK_PENDING_TIMEOUT to SETTLED using the clearing identifier EBA-STEP2-9948102 from the authoritative CAMT.053 feed. Update monitoring logic to require verification against end-of-window reconciliation before issuing automated rollback alerts on transient HTTP timeouts.
